people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Ramoth
people.line: City of refuge east of the Jordan

translations.web: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.
translations.bsb: And the LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel to march up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one suggested this, and another that.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
